title.zh: 只用水平的回返、新与遗忘
title.en: Returning, novelty and forgetting on the levels alone

statement.zh: 只用水平：存量在界内的部分回返；每步都新的部分超出每个界；在界内而交换不止的部分与有限的整体不承载其历史；每次变化都下降时，变化不无尽复现。
statement.en: On the levels alone, a part whose stock stays within a bound returns; a part new at every step exceeds every bound; a bounded part exchanged with without end, and a finite whole, do not carry their history; with loss at each change, change does not recur without end.

laws.zh: 存量从 T 起在界 K 内时，构型都在总量至多 K 的有限构型列表中，所以从每一步起都有两步构型相同；不升的存量以 T 处为界；不断变化时，从不重访不成立。
laws.en: With the stock within a bound K from T on, the configurations lie in the finite list of those totalling at most K, so from every step on two steps have the same configuration; a stock that never rises is bounded by its value at T; changing without end, never revisiting is refuted.

laws.zh: T 到 T + N 各步的构型两两不同、N 为界内构型之数时，其中某一步存量超出界；这一步由核对有限多个不等式找到，不判定任何无穷的事。所以每步都新的在任意晚处超出每个界，不断变化而从不重访的不在任何界内；Web.counting 的水平就是步数。
laws.en: A family whose configurations at the steps T, …, T + N all differ, N the number of configurations within the bound, has its stock above the bound at one of those steps, found by checking finitely many inequalities, deciding nothing infinite. So what is new at every step exceeds every bound arbitrarily late, and what changes without end and never revisits stays within no bound; in Web.counting the level is the step.

laws.zh: 在界内的家族，其构型的任何读数都给不出从不重复的记录或无界的计数；所以在界内、在任意晚处被交换的家族，其构型不承载其交换的计数，不论流如何；对整体，在有限多关系项就是全部时亦然。
laws.en: No reading of a bounded family's configuration gives a record that never repeats or a count without bound; so a bounded family exchanged with at arbitrarily late steps does not carry the count of its exchanges, whatever the flow, and nor does the whole where finitely many relata are all there is.

laws.zh: 存量不升、每次构型变化都下降时，家族从不重访，任一段上变化的次数加终点的存量不超过起点的存量，变化不无尽复现。
laws.en: With the stock never rising and falling across each change of configuration, the family never revisits, the changes over a stretch with the stock at its end are at most the stock at its start, and change does not recur without end.

laws.zh: 平衡且不增益时存量以 T 处为界；以此为界，上面的规律给出 Becoming.Entropy 在第一律之下的回返、静止与遗忘。算入其余时不设平衡：算入其余仍不增益的家族以 T 处的存量为界。
laws.en: Balanced and gaining nothing, the stock is bounded by its value at T; with that bound the laws above give Becoming.Entropy's returning, resting and forgetting under the first law. With the rest counted no balance is supposed: a family gaining nothing with its rest counted is bounded by its stock at T.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。每条规律的条件写在其中：家族的存量从 T 起在界内、从不上升，或每次变化都下降；交换在任意晚处发生；对整体，一个列表持有每个关系项。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. Each law's condition is written into it: the family's stock within a bound from T on, never rising, or falling across each change; exchange at arbitrarily late steps; for the whole, a list holding every relatum.

hypotheses.zh: upto_or_fails 以所核对的性质可判定为条件；exceeds_of_new 只用自然数不等式的判定。重访不可判定，returns_of_bounded 以否定的否定陈述。
hypotheses.en: upto_or_fails takes the checked property decided as a condition; exceeds_of_new uses only the decision of inequalities of natural numbers. Revisiting is not decided, and returns_of_bounded is stated with a double negation.

does_not_show.zh: 哪些部分在界内、不增益或每次变化都损失：这些是部分的状态，作为规律的条件给出。
does_not_show.en: Which parts are held within a bound, gain nothing or lose at each change: these are states of the part, given as conditions of the laws.

does_not_show.zh: returns_of_bounded 的否定的否定不去掉：从“从不重访”被否证，算不出回返之步。
does_not_show.en: The double negation of returns_of_bounded is not removed: from never revisiting being refuted, no step of return is computed.

does_not_show.zh: 与热力学的熵、物理的复现（Poincaré）或记忆容量的对应不由此检查。
does_not_show.en: No correspondence to thermodynamic entropy, physical recurrence (Poincaré) or memory capacity is checked.

does_not_show.zh: 连续时间与实数的量没有陈述。
does_not_show.en: Continuous time and real amounts are not stated.

detail.zh: Web.counting：水平就是步数，每步都新且超出每个界（Web.counting_new、Web.counting_gains）；规律中的界不能去掉。
detail.en: Web.counting: the level is the step, new at every step and above every bound (Web.counting_new, Web.counting_gains); the bound in the laws cannot be dropped.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执于落地时绑定）：Becoming.Novelty 的 20 项声明（19 项定理）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。作者反审见研究 §124；未经独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt bound at landing): the 20 declarations of Becoming.Novelty, 19 of them theorems, have empty axiom reports; the checker verifies core purity. Author counterreview in study section 124; not independently reviewed.

next_delta.zh: 分支过程上的同样规律（Becoming.Branching），界作为部分的状态；连续时间与实数的量；独立审查；Ren 对读法（曲率、来自部分之外的增益、有界的当下）的判断。
next_delta.en: The same laws over branching processes (Becoming.Branching), with the bound as a state of the part; continuous time and real amounts; an independent review; Ren's judgment on the readings (curvature, gain from beyond the part, the bounded present).

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-14：“why do we need "World"? wasn't this about the whole and its parts, about everything?”，“no hard role has to be so - right now i think we are trapped by our speculative conditions”，“for us, non-Euclidean, or causality, still work”；对从关系开始的三步重建：“please, finish all”。本结果是第一步：规律不带推测的条件。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：每个条件是它所说的部分的状态，如曲率是区域的状态，所以必然的规律不需要必然的条件；回返是有界的部分所做的；新而不止是无界的增益，必须来自部分之外；有界的当下不能承载自身的历史；每次变化都损失时，变化在至多与单位一样多的变化之内结束。
correspondence.en: Ren, 14 October 2026: “why do we need "World"? wasn't this about the whole and its parts, about everything?”, “no hard role has to be so - right now i think we are trapped by our speculative conditions”, “for us, non-Euclidean, or causality, still work”; and, to the relation-first re-founding in three steps, “please, finish all”. This result is the first step: the laws without the speculative conditions. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): each condition is a state of the part the law is about, as curvature is a state of a region, so a necessary law needs no necessary condition; returning is what a bounded part does; novelty without end is gain without bound, which must come from beyond the part; a bounded present cannot hold its own history; and loss at each change ends change within as many changes as there are units.

aliases: laws of returning on the levels alone

output.zh: 家族的构型与总量内构型的有限列表；交换的计数及其承载；第一律之下的回返、静止与遗忘。
output.en: A family's configuration and the finite list of configurations within a total; the count of exchanges and carrying it; returning, resting and forgetting under the first law.

input.zh: 同样的规律只用水平，界作为部分的状态。
input.en: The same laws on the levels alone, the bound a state of the part.

detail.zh: 复用 revisits_from、revisits_within、sumOver 与 le_sumOver：有限多构型中的鸽巢式重访与读数之界。
detail.en: Reuses revisits_from, revisits_within, sumOver and le_sumOver: pigeonhole revisiting within finitely many configurations and the bound on a reading.

output.zh: 有限多构型中的序列从每一步起都重访。
output.en: A sequence within finitely many configurations revisits from every step on.

input.zh: 存量之界给出有限多构型。
input.en: A bound on the stock gives finitely many configurations.

detail.zh: 复用 Flow.withImbalance 与 Flow.withImbalance_balances：算入其余时每个流都平衡。
detail.en: Reuses Flow.withImbalance and Flow.withImbalance_balances: with the rest counted, every flow balances.

output.zh: 算入不平衡，每个流都平衡。
output.en: With the imbalance counted, every flow balances.

input.en: The bound on the stock with the rest counted.

detail.zh: 那里不加前提的规律对每个世界成立，前提划出部分；这里每条规律的条件是它所说的部分的状态。
detail.en: There premise-free laws hold of every world and premises carve parts; here each law's condition is a state of the part it is about.

detail.zh: 推进其下一步：回返、新与遗忘不需世界的前提，只需部分的状态；不说明每个生成都这样表示。
detail.en: Advances its next step: returning, novelty and forgetting need no premise of the world, only states of parts; it does not show that every becoming is so represented.

detail.zh: 同一重建的第二步：前提从交换读出，余下的是部分的状态。
detail.en: Step 2 of the same re-founding: the premises read off the exchange, with states of parts remaining.
